subject.title: fix(reply): strip leaked current-message scaffolding and (no output) placeholders

question: Should this PR's shared `empty-tool-output` skip behavior land as a non-silent delivery skip, or should maintainers require different fallback semantics before merge?
rationale: The patch appears correct for stripping leaked scaffolding, but the new skip reason is a cross-channel delivery contract that channel handlers can observe differently.

options.title: Accept after clean checks
options.body: Merge once the broad CI failures are rerun or triaged, keeping `empty-tool-output` as an observable non-silent skip reason.

options.title: Request transport proof first
options.body: Ask for Telegram Desktop proof before merge if maintainers want visible confirmation of fallback and non-text payload behavior.

options.title: Revise skip semantics
options.body: Require the PR to make `(no output)` behave like a silent skip or otherwise document a different channel fallback contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after clean checks
recommendation.body: Merge once the broad CI failures are rerun or triaged, keeping `empty-tool-output` as an observable non-silent skip reason.
